note: Draft picks for the S5 map rail, for Vali to approve. 'src' are unaltered downscales in media/web (longest side 1600 px, q82, EXIF orientation applied, metadata stripped); 'original' is the Commons file. Credit and licence still apply (CC BY-SA 4.0 for the protest photos). Captions are the Commons descriptions verbatim; 'alt' and 'place' are written by the picker and are not sourced facts, so don't render 'place' as a claim. Beats with an empty list have no openly licensed photo of that date. The 20 Jul set covers only 07:35–07:56, the morning gathering at Jantar Mantar. No open photo shows the march, Sansad Marg or the clashes, so an hour-by-hour 20 Jul sequence can't be built from these: 'sansad_chalo' is minute-by-minute over 21 minutes. Most photos show identifiable young protesters; see identifiable_faces and docs on blurring (a blurred CC BY-SA image must itself be released CC BY-SA). The 21 Jul photos from Commons users Raydann and Alnitak-Alnilam-Mintaka come from the same iPhone 12 (same iOS build, interleaved timestamps): probably one photographer with two accounts; check before crediting.
